title: Accession record — Box 17
summary: The teaching document. Completely ordinary, and its job is to be: it establishes the interface, the register and the typography on something with nothing wrong with it, so that the ledger page later has a norm to depart from. Grants no knowledge, deliberately.

blocks.label: Condition
blocks.text: Fair. Some water damage to the underside.
Contents as received: sports day programmes (bundled), class photographs (loose), attendance ledgers vols. I-III, assorted correspondence, one tin.
Numbering to be completed on cataloguing. Items not listed individually at time of receipt.
tin is biscuits. actual biscuits. binned. — I.
